Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to common questions about coaching with Coach RJ.

What if I don't have access to a gym?

Most of the exercises in our programs can be done at home with minimal equipment. I'll include a variety of options that work with whatever equipment you have available, whether that's just bodyweight or some dumbbells.

How often do we check in?

Check-in frequency depends on your coaching level. Premium coaching includes weekly video check-ins, while Base Coaching offers bi-weekly options. Teams and Organizations have customized schedules based on the group's needs.

Can I modify a program if my schedule changes?

Absolutely. Programs are designed to be flexible, and I'm happy to adjust volume, intensity, or timing to accommodate schedule changes. Communication is key to keeping your training on track.

What if I get injured?

We have protocols in place for injury management. If you're injured, we can modify your program to protect the injured area while still maintaining strength and conditioning. Always consult with your healthcare provider before making any major changes.

Do you offer trial programs?

Yes! We offer trial coaching periods to ensure we're a good fit before committing to a longer program. This gives you time to see if the coaching style and program structure work for you.

Can I work with you part-time?

Yes, we have flexible options for part-time coaching. Whether you need 2 weeks of programming or 8, we can structure the program to fit your specific needs and timeline.
